cfg.title: Chemicals lifepaths
cfg.sub: Each dot is one chemical (MeSH substance) at a half-year snapshot. Counts are small (5,588 mentions across the 233 chemicals with 5 or more papers), so most fits rest on few papers. Color by switches to the same four wave groups and three lifepath archetypes used for diseases. No chemical has enough papers to be grouped on its own, so each one is assigned by a timing model to the disease group whose quarterly volume it most resembles; fainter means less certain. Thinning tests on diseases put this at about 44% correct at 5 papers and 65% at 50 (25% by chance), so read the groups as tentative. Chemical tagging shows no dip, so no gap fill is applied. Mentions tagged without an identifier are left out.
